user.title: Marao Dashboard
user.description: Install the Marao Dashboard builder, cards, and theme. Required community cards are installed separately through HACS.

missing_dashboard_dependencies.title: Marao Dashboard dependencies were not detected
missing_dashboard_dependencies.description: The current dashboard uses these independently installed community cards, but their resources were not detected: {dependencies}. Install or register them through HACS, then use Recheck in the Marao builder. A manually renamed resource may also appear as not detected.

legacy_vendor_resources.title: Remove old Marao bundled-card resources
legacy_vendor_resources.description: Marao no longer bundles third-party dashboard cards. Remove these legacy entries from your YAML Lovelace resources, then restart Home Assistant: {resources}

generate_dashboard.name: Generate dashboard
generate_dashboard.description: Generate the Marao Dashboard YAML dashboard from dashboard.json.

config_path.name: Config path
config_path.description: Path to the dashboard JSON config, relative to /config unless absolute.

dry_run.description: Validate and report planned files without writing YAML or patching configuration.yaml.
